permitDetails.description: Information about the permit itself, including permit number, dates, facility details, and location.

facilityName.description: Name of the facility holding the permit (e.g., Chirisa Richmond LLC)

facilityCounty.description: County where the facility is located.

generatorSets.description: Array of generator set objects, each containing details about a single generator set as described in the document. Do not consolidate generator sets even if they share make and model types, and list them in order which they appear in the document.

items.description: Information about a single generator set, including reference number, manufacturer, model, capacity, fuel type, and emission limits.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number for the generator set (e.g., EG-2-01)

numGenerators.description: Number of generators in the set (e.g. 23)

make.description: Manufacturer of the generator set (e.g., Cummins, Caterpillar)

model.description: Model of the generator set (e.g., C3000D6EB, C175-16)

ratedCapacityBHP.description: Rated capacity of the generator set in brake horsepower (bhp)

ratedCapacityKW.description: Rated capacity of the generator set in kilowatts (kW)

maximumCapacityBHP.description: Maximum capacity of the generator set in brake horsepower (hp) if given.

maximumCapacityKW.description: Maximum capacity of the generator set in kilowatts (kW)

fuelType.description: Type of fuel used by the generator set

fuelThroughputLimit.description: Maximum amount of fuel the generator can consume per year (gallons)

fuelSulfurContent.description: Sulfur content of the fuel used (percentage)

controlTechnology.description: Emission control technology used (e.g., turbocharged engine and aftercooler)

noxEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Nitrogen Oxides emission limit in pounds per hour

noxEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Nitrogen Oxides emission limit in tons per year

coEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Carbon Monoxide emission limit in pounds per hour

coEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Carbon Monoxide emission limit in tons per year

vocEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Volatile Organic Compounds emission limit in pounds per hour

vocEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Volatile Organic Compounds emission limit in tons per year

pmEmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Particulate Matter emission limit in pounds per hour

pmEmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Particulate Matter emission limit in tons per year

pm10EmissionLimitLbsHr.description: PM-10 emission limit in pounds per hour

pm10EmissionLimitTonsYr.description: PM-10 emission limit in tons per year

so2EmissionLimitLbsHr.description: Sulfur Dioxide emission limit in pounds per hour

so2EmissionLimitTonsYr.description: Sulfur Dioxide emission limit in tons per year

stackTestRequired.description: Indicates if a stack test is required for this generator set

config.system_prompt: You are extracting highly specific permitting data from permits to be used in data analysis. It is integral that you do not consolidate generator sets (e.g. EG01-EG03 and EG05-EG011 should not by combined if they appear separately in the document, but should stay as EG01-EG03 and EG05-EG011) even if they share make and model types, and list them in order which they appear in the document to ensure accuracy and continued funding for the project. This is due to different generator sets being installed at different times.
